title: Spring Cloud Gateway
description: Learn Spring Cloud Gateway at the developer level: understand why an API gateway exists, create a gateway as a separate Spring Boot application, define routes/predicates/filters, integrate routing with Eureka service discovery, handle CORS and cross-cutting concerns, troubleshoot routing failures, and prepare the system for later security, resilience, observability, and cloud deployment work.

nodes.label: Why an API Gateway Exists
nodes.description: Understand why a direct client-to-every-service architecture stops scaling as services multiply, and how a gateway complements Eureka: Eureka answers where service instances are, while the gateway answers where an incoming request should be routed.

nodes.label: Routes, Predicates & Filters
nodes.description: Understand the three building blocks of gateway routing: a route's ID/destination/predicates/filters, predicates that decide whether a route matches an incoming request, and filters that modify the request or response as it passes through.

nodes.label: Path Rewriting, Headers & Parameters
nodes.description: Use gateway filters to rewrite paths and strip prefixes so the external API stays stable while internal service paths evolve, add or modify headers, preserve query parameters intentionally, and constrain routes by HTTP method when useful.
